author: Stahly
description:
June and July were so jam-packed with a truckload of new starter and army sets that we were simply too busy for a monthly best-of. So now we're combining the best of two months into one: all 11th Edition 40k starter sets unboxed, the new Starcraft TMG, new Old World Chaos Warriors, MkIV Legionaries, Ogors, Ultracryl, patina & drybrush paint tests, the start of a miniature photography masterclass, and of course countless lovingly painted models. All that in this post.

The post The best of Tale of Painters: June & July 2026 appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The best of Tale of Painters: June & July 2026
